T0015.title: Direct Order
T0015.definition: A task execution method where orders are placed at the original price without using any coupons or discounts.
T0015.description: 'Naked ordering' is common in scenarios where sellers are brushing their own sales volume or in proxy purchasing schemes. Participants place orders at full price, and the merchant later refunds the cost and pays a commission through rebates. This method circumvents platform risk controls that monitor coupon stacking, making the transaction appear more like a genuine purchase and reducing the risk of being flagged as fake.

references.title: Black Market Big Data: E-commerce Scalper Industry Chain Analysis Report

T0015.usageExample: Because the platform's risk control system strictly audits voucher usage, the fraud ring opted for a direct order approach to complete the task at full price without triggering any alerts.
